poi.name: Madaba Art Space & Gallery
poi.address: King Hussein Street, Madaba, Jordan

highlights: Exhibitions featuring contemporary Jordanian painters and sculptors
Historic heritage house atmosphere with central stone courtyard
Opportunity to purchase original art pieces and artisan prints
facts.notes: Free public admission; gallery sales support local working artists.

poi.name: Wadi Hidan Canyon
poi.address: Wadi Hidan Access Road, Dhiban District, Jordan

highlights: Swinging and swimming through deep black basalt canyon pools
Natural freshwater waterfalls flowing year-round
Guided eco-adventure water trekking trails
facts.notes: Operations subject to seasonal weather; closed during heavy winter rains due to flash flood safety.

poi.name: Wadi Mujib Biosphere Reserve (Madaba Approach)
poi.address: Dead Sea Highway, Madaba Governorate, Jordan

highlights: Water-hiking through deep, dramatic sandstone Siq gorge
Climbing up natural waterfalls using ropes and metal ladders
Unique flora and fauna in the lowest altitude nature reserve in the world
Swimming in natural river plunge pools
facts.notes: Closed in winter season (November to March) due to flash flood risk. Ability to swim mandatory.

poi.name: Madaba Institute for Mosaic Art and Restoration (MIMAR)
poi.address: Palestine St., Madaba, Jordan

highlights: Watch live creation and restoration of natural stone mosaics
Interact with mosaic conservation diploma students
Authentic artisan mosaic artworks available for viewing
Unique insight into regional heritage preservation techniques
facts.notes: Visiting during active student workshop hours (weekdays) offers best experience.
Also offers mosaic art workshops and locally produced traditional crafts.

poi.name: Dead Sea Panorama Complex (Madaba Overlook)
poi.address: Panorama Complex Road, Off Ma'in Road, Madaba Governorate, Jordan

highlights: Unrivaled cliff-edge viewpoint looking down over the entire Dead Sea basin
Exhibits detailing the formation and environmental conservation of the Dead Sea
Cliff-edge sunset viewing terrace and botanical walk
Spectacular photography opportunities
facts.notes: Excellent sunset stop when traveling between Madaba and the Dead Sea resorts.

poi.name: King's Highway Madaba Segment
poi.address: Route 35, Madaba Governorate, Jordan

highlights: Traverse one of the oldest continuously used high roads in world history
Dramatic mountain switchbacks plunging into deep desert canyons
Rustic roadside coffee stalls overlooking agricultural plains
facts.notes: Mountainous driving conditions; drive carefully around canyon hairpin turns.

poi.name: Madaba Visitor Center
poi.address: Palestine Street, Madaba, Jordan

highlights: Free tourism maps and regional travel guides
Restored 19th-century Ottoman domestic architectural courtyard
Official Ministry of Tourism staff assistance and guide booking
facts.notes: Ideal first stop upon arriving in Madaba to collect self-guided walking maps.
Features local artisan workshops and souvenir stalls on site.

poi.name: Al-Lajjun / East Madaba Desert Border Viewpoint
poi.address: East Madaba Ring Road, Madaba Governorate, Jordan

highlights: Unobstructed views over vast desert steppe landscapes
Geographic border transition zone from green fields to desert
Quiet rural location ideal for landscape photography
facts.notes: Informal roadside viewpoint accessible via car.

poi.name: La Storica Mosaics (Mosaic Handicrafts Center)
poi.address: Mount Nebo Road, Madaba Governorate, Jordan

highlights: Live demonstration of manual stone-cutting and mosaic construction
Large gallery of natural stone mosaic art available for purchase
Custom mosaic order services with global shipping options
Opportunity to try placing mosaic tiles

Seasonal menu changes frequently based on local farm harvests.

poi.name: Madaba Museum

Collection of traditional 19th and 20th-century Jordanian attire
Ancient bronze tools, coins, and Roman pottery

meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 3 days (nights=2). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Dead Sea, Wadi Rum. Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: Dead Sea→cluster 0 (Madaba Governorate · culture); Wadi Rum→cluster 1 (Ma'an Governorate · culture)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Dead Sea → D2:C1/Wadi Rum part 1 → D3:C2/Wadi Rum part 2
- mustVisit entity lock: Wadi Rum→lead with Barrah Canyon (cluster 1)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C0: Madaba Art Space & Gallery + Madaba Institute for Mosaic Art and Restoration (MIMAR) + Madaba Visitor Center + Madaba Museum; C1: Rum Village Bedouin Oasis + Desert Police Station & Fort (Wadi Rum); C1: Neolithic Village of Beidha + Little Petra (Siq al-Barid); C2: Madaba Crafts Souk + Sayyidat al-Jabal (Our Lady of the Mount) Church
- Lodging requested: rating=3 star, type=hotel. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): Saint John Hotel [3-star]; N2(C1): Cleopetra Hotel [3-star]
- Money: 900 JOD covers 2 traveller(s) for 3 days (≈300 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 2 night(s) x ~1 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority=budget → take the cheaper of two comparable options and note the saving. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.

geographic.clustering_rule: Keep each day geographically coherent. Avoid unnecessary cross-country hops.

budget.guidance: Comfort-oriented stays and dining when listed places exist.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.
decisions.effect: Your days follow Amman, then Wadi Rum (2 days).

decisions.title: This trip stays in one part of Jordan
decisions.why: 3 days is too short for both the north and the south.
decisions.effect: So this journey focuses on the south, and those places get proper time.

decisions.title: Your first night is near the airport
decisions.effect: Night one is a hotel in Amman, as close to the airport as the listings allow.

decisions.title: Settle in this evening
decisions.effect: Dinner near the hotel, then rest. No sightseeing after a late-day flight.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Your must-see places get proper time
decisions.why: Wadi Rum were marked as required.
decisions.effect: Those places are planned from real sites in that area, not borrowed from a nearby city.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: About 3 places to visit and 2 meals each day.

decisions.title: 3 star stays
decisions.effect: Hotels are taken from listings at that star level when the city has them. If it does not, we use the closest listed tier and say so.

decisions.title: A comfort budget
decisions.effect: We lean toward more comfortable stays and dining when those places exist.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about
decisions.effect: Sights, meals, and local hosts are matched to these. Unrelated places stay out.

decision_rules: Never invent POIs, hotels, restaurants, SMEs, prices, hours, or coordinates.

Must-visit destinations are hard constraints unless impossible.
Honor places_to_avoid as a hard exclusion.
Target about 3 sights and 2 meals per day for a Balanced pace.

Tourist relevance always outranks commercial promotion.
